hypothesis: An overtime game creates extra workload that may reduce the next game's combined scoring relative to the publisher closing total benchmark, compared with games whose two teams last played without overtime.
distinction: Fixed lagged-overtime totals diagnostic from agenda item 7. Related fatigue mechanisms and failed NBA B2B spread replication remain disclosed; this is neither a reversal nor a cutoff rescue of that rule.

source.license: Existing private publisher-CC-BY4.0-labeled file only; upstream rights uncertified. No new download or redistribution.
source.benchmark: close_total and close_over_prob. Closing consensus is neither independent fair value nor a decision-time executable price.

prior_exposure: Entire 2025-26 source season already inspected for B2B spreads and is development evidence. Only header/hash and existing implementation/protocol were read for this registration; no new overtime subgroup counts, labels, outcome contrasts or sample-size reconnaissance. 2024-25 remains excluded from this experiment.
population: 2025-26 regular season only, ET dates in [2025-07-01,2026-07-01). Postseason excluded and cannot supply a prior regular-season game.
gates: Exact source bytes/hash match; unique nonempty game IDs, stable one-to-one team ID/name identities, distinct sides, unique team starts, timezone-aware UTC timestamps matching ET date.

Validate every regular row's integer nonnegative unequal scores, finite positive closing total and 0<close_over_prob<1 before population exclusions. Recompute total_margin and total_result and require publisher agreement using documented orientation.

Before opening rows for evaluation, retain publisher documentation establishing overtime field encoding and whether close_over_prob is a de-vigged full-game including-overtime probability. Do not infer encoding or probability meaning from observed outcomes. Missing/ambiguous documentation => data_blocked; no substitute metric or changed hypothesis.

Known omitted Cup games: exclude all December 2025 candidates. Retain prior regular source games in chronological history; for each January 2026 regular row require both teams' previous source games after 2025-12-16 or abort unresolved Cup coverage. Full independent schedule completeness is uncertified, even if this gate passes.

All histories strictly earlier than the current start; same-team equal starts abort. Prior means immediate previous source-listed regular game, never a selected qualifying prior. No score/margin/line of current game may affect workload labels.

feature.elapsed: Both teams must have immediate prior regular games with elapsed prior-start to current-start in [18,72] hours inclusive, exact timestamp comparison.
feature.treated: Exactly one team's immediate previous regular game has documented overtime=true; the other has overtime=false. Count each current game once.
feature.controls: Both teams' immediate previous regular games have documented overtime=false with the identical elapsed-hour window.
feature.exclusions: Missing prior, elapsed window unmet, both prior games overtime, December 2025 candidates, and current closing total not a positive exact half point are excluded; report nonexclusive exclusion flags plus one deterministic primary reason in this listed order. Never tune windows or split home/away/rest/underdog bands.

outcomes: For each included full-game half-point total, y_under=1 if final home+away score<close_total, else 0. No push possible; equality aborts inconsistent contract. Residual=y_under-(1-close_over_prob). Current overtime is included in final scores, never used as a selection feature.
primary: ET Monday calendar week mean treated residual minus mean control residual; weight comparable weeks by treated game count. Sum(n_treated*weekly_contrast)/sum(n_treated). Weeks with either arm absent contribute zero weight. No global-control substitution. Predicted sign positive.

uncertainty.method: Full contiguous Monday-ET week grid from first to last population-eligible regular game (including zero-weight weeks); circular 4-week blocks, ceil(number_of_weeks/4) blocks, truncate final draw to original week-grid length. Resample whole weeks and recompute treated-weighted primary.
uncertainty.interval: 99% two-sided percentile; sorted valid draws linear interpolation at (n-1)*q for q=.005,.995; report skipped zero-weight draws, never redraw to reach a target.

decision: Descriptive lead only if primary>=0.03 AND lower99%>0 AND all minimums/gates pass. Otherwise not_supported or insufficient_data; schema/meaning/coverage failure data_blocked/aborted. No reverse rule, extra seasons, alternative totals outcome, cutoff rescue, player props or pick/model promotion.
multiplicity: One fixed primary; retain all 21 earlier registry entries and failures. This 99% interval is not project-wide familywise-error control or independent confirmation on reused outcomes. Future confirmation needs separately registered new/prospective evidence.
limits: Prior overtime is endogenous to team strength, prior close contests and scheduling. No causal workload/rotation/minutes effect; other rest-window differences and team/week dependence remain. No actual priced ROI, CLV, liquidity, fees, limits, injury readiness, NY offer or earlier-information claim.
next: Document field semantics first; implement offline labels/audits/statistic/bootstrap with synthetic tests, commit and pass hosted CI before actual group evaluation. Preserve this protocol unchanged; if semantics blocked stop without inspecting OT groups.
